description_en: Creates an enterprise code by calling CreateEnterpriseCode
name: CreateEnterpriseCode

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and the corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html查询智能接入网关支持的地域及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise code.

The enterprise code must be 5 characters in length and contain both letters and digits. The letters can be uppercase or lowercase. The enterprise code must be globally unique and cannot be the same as that of another enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
企业码。

企业码长度为5个字符，必须包含字母和数字，字母可以是大写或者小写。企业码必须与其他企业码不重复，保证全球唯一
parameters.name: enterprise_code

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
